bio.text: Carlos De La Cruz is the Republican nominee for Texas's 35th Congressional District, having defeated state Rep. John Lujan in the May 26, 2026 primary runoff.

He is a U.S. Air Force veteran who, in a San Antonio Report interview, said he served 20 years in the Air Force, including deployments to the Middle East, and opened a kickboxing gym in San Antonio in 2018.
The San Antonio Report reported he had never run for office before, and that he is the younger brother of U.S. Rep. Monica De La Cruz (R-Edinburg).
